title: gen_CT
summary: A research codebase for continual/incremental learning on tabular malware feature data (using EMBER PE features), organized into sequential class-incremental tasks. It uses the standalone rdt library's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder transformers to preprocess tabular data and the standalone ctgan package's CTGAN model to generate synthetic replay samples.
